serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin; each bucket's own table for bookedMin; service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled labour minutes available in that bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative load from the bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity' (not an all-order ceiling), and null means not configured rather than a ceiling of zero
